title: SearchSpace
description: space.yaml, the input of servtuner propose: what a tuning session may change and how. Beyond the schema, servtuner propose checks that every knob is a vLLM or an SGLang knob and the space tunes one server, that a knob lists values or bounds but not both, that only the range-tuned knobs (vLLM's max_num_seqs, max_num_batched_tokens and max_model_len; SGLang's max_running_requests, chunked_prefill_size and context_length) take bounds, and that no knob is both in base and tuned. Defaults: objective slo_rps_per_gpu, noise_floor 0.05, confirm top 3 and repeats 3; ladder probe_rps 1 to 128 doubling, screen_factors [0.7, 0.85, 1, 1.15, 1.3], full_factors [0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 0.95, 1, 1.05, 1.15, 1.3, 1.5].

noise_floor.description: The run-to-run noise as a fraction: a challenger must beat the leader by more than this to take over. Default 0.05.

min_concurrency.description: The concurrency the workload preset needs the KV cache to hold: a boot probe whose c_kv is below it drops the configuration. Absent or 0 means no check.

base.description: Knobs set on every configuration and never tuned.

tuningTier.description: The stages of the search, in this order: feasibility (boot probes with no load), structural, scheduler (advisor-guided), fine_tuning.

values.description: The allowed values. Required except for the knobs the advisors move, which may give min and max instead.

default.description: The value of the first run. Absent means vLLM's own default: the knob is left unset (a structural knob takes its first value).

probe_rps.description: The first ladder of a session, in requests per second, before any SLO-max is known.

screen_factors.description: Multiples of the leader's SLO-max: the screening ladder.

full_factors.description: Multiples of the leader's SLO-max: the confirmation ladder.

top.description: How many configurations get the full ladder and repeats. Default 3.

repeats.description: Repeats of each confirmed configuration. Default 3.
